summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests inavolisib given with fulvestrant in adults with PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer that is locally advanced or metastatic. Inavolisib is taken by mouth as a tablet, and fulvestrant is given as an intramuscular injection; the study compares two inavolisib dose levels, and the treatment schedule is in the protocol and not stated in the record. The main outcome the study measures is not stated, and the study is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa inavolisib junto con fulvestrant en adultos con cáncer de mama con mutación en PIK3CA, positivo para receptores hormonales y negativo para HER2, que es localmente avanzado o metastásico. El inavolisib se toma por vía oral en forma de tableta, y el fulvestrant se administra como inyección intramuscular; el estudio compara dos dosis de inavolisib, y el calendario de tratamiento está en el protocolo y no se indica en el registro. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica, y el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: ER-positive and HER2-negative tumor by ASCO/CAP guidelines
Disease progressed after or during a CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy, with no more than 1 prior line in the advanced setting
Measurable or evaluable disease by RECIST v1.1, with at least one PIK3CA mutation confirmed and life expectancy over 6 months
not_for: Prior chemotherapy in the recurrent, locally advanced or metastatic setting
Type 2 diabetes needing ongoing systemic treatment, or any history of type 1 diabetes
Prior PI3K, Akt or mTOR inhibitor treatment in the recurrent, locally advanced or metastatic setting
Daily supplemental oxygen need or symptomatic active lung disease, including pneumonitis
